motivation: The pre-2026 admission winner raises union/common-five wealth and lowers turnover, but common-five drawdown remains47.06%. Individual stops and admission confirmation do not limit a sequence of correlated losses. Test a separate account-level capital cushion whose equity peak never resets, rather than tighter date-fitted stock stops.

rules.high_water: max of actual complete-session NAV from inception; never reset either control or reported peak
rules.exposure_ceiling: clip(multiplier * (NAV - (1-drawdown_budget)*permanent_peak) / NAV,0.10,1.0). The10% floor permits recovery but means this is explicitly NOT a guaranteed hard drawdown bound.
rules.reduction: When desired exposure exceeds the ceiling by more than1% of account NAV, proportionally reduce; per-name complete exits remain untouched. Keep absolute-unit reduction intent until actual execution. Do not cancel unfilled risk reductions on a quote rebound.
rules.restoration: Only after the underlying three-close market admission is open, no pending reduction remains, and ceiling exceeds actual exposure by at least10percentage points; refill surviving intended membership proportionally, with80% per-name drift ceiling or100% singleton, never using intended sale proceeds.
rules.execution: No changes to next-open engine, fees, minimum lots, prior liquidity, blocked fills,1% ordinary materiality or original acceptance. Execution dust at most1% NAV may remain. No intraday or same-day new-share sale assumption. No leverage.

selection_rule: Same necessary incumbent wealth/drawdown/order nonregression and minimax deficit screen; preserve every candidate and the failed predecessor families. Original return/risk/generalization goals unchanged. Already observed2026 is retrospective.
